title: Two reading cards: recorded exact, estimate has a badge
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view customers (and edit customers to add or change a record), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open an asset page and its Maintenance tab (the last tab, after Notes). The asset card is on the left; the Compliance section sits below Contact.
  3. An enrolled unit on its Maintenance tab. Seed it: enrol an asset (asset Maintenance tab -> Enrol -> pick a schedule).
  4. The unit has a recorded mileage reading and an estimated engine-hours reading.
custom_steps:
1. Read the two reading cards (mileage left, engine hours right).
  2. On a recorded reading check for any qualifier; on an estimate check the badge and its basis.
  3. Check the colour of a Low-confidence meter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The tab opens with current readings - distance and engine hours - each showing whether it is recorded or estimated, with its age.
  • A recorded reading shows the exact value with no qualifier; an estimate carries a badge and its basis.
  • The confidence meter's Low state is never red (red is reserved for overdue).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S9 (confidence display copied from S11); read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
